I have been farming this land for many years and I know sorghum needs some fertilizer to do well in our soils here in the North East. I will spread manure from my animals and also buy some bags of NPK from the market because I have some formal schooling and understand it helps the crop. I plant local sorghum seed that I have kept from last season because it is trustworthy and does well here. My family will do most of the work on this plot, but I will hire a few young men during planting and harvest when the labor is heavy, since I am getting older.
